title: Up to two errors
note: The library's reason to exist: a pattern that still matches when the subject is not quite right. {e<=2} allows up to two errors of any kind.
subject: the color of the collar

title: Per-error-type limits
note: Errors are counted separately, so a pattern can allow a substitution without allowing a deletion. Every match reports what it actually spent.
subject: xfoobat

title: Best match, not first match
note: Without BestMatch the engine returns the leftmost match it can reach. With it, the engine keeps looking and returns the cheapest one.
subject: the sitting kitten

title: Enhanced match
note: EnhanceMatch keeps the same span and reduces the errors inside it, so the reported cost is the honest one.
subject: the organisers organized it

title: Named groups and every capture
note: A repeated group keeps all of its captures, not only the last. That list is what the group table shows under each group.
subject: alpha, beta, gamma

title: Set operations
note: Character sets can be subtracted from one another: word characters that are not digits.
subject: abc123def456

title: Unicode properties
note: A script property matches by what a character is, not by where it sits in an alphabet.
subject: alpha then αβγ then beta

title: Case-insensitive, with a flag
note: Flags are typed by name, so a typo is an error rather than a different set of flags. Try IgnoreCase here, then take it away.
